snippet.title: 3D Life Trailer
snippet.description:
The classic game of cellular automata in 3D and VR. From simple rules come spaceships, oscillators and other life forms unique to each rule set.

Cells grow, fly, and spin in endless unique patterns. Control the game speed, start and stop time. Use your flashlight to generate cells in three ways: randomly, frozen, or spaceships. From millions of cells come infinite possibilities.

This game is VR-only. It requires a SteamVR-compatible headset and motion controllers.
